title: GPU-Aware Sparse Matrices for R

code: library(cudasparsr) library(Matrix)  counts <- rsparsematrix(1000, 500, density = 0.01) x <- cuda_sparse(counts)  sparse_info(x) sparse_row_sums(x) sparse_col_sums(x)  dense <- matrix(rnorm(500 * 10), 500, 10) result <- sparse_matmul_dense(x, dense)

title: GPU-Aware Sparse Matrices for R
text: public R torch API provides documented COO constructor. CUDA objects therefore use coalesced torch COO tensor internally even logical format recorded CSR. CSR metadata still exposed future native cuSPARSE integration. first release, dense products returned CPU CUDA computation. Printing objects 100 stored values shows metadata, avoiding unexpected full sparse-matrix materialization. Use to_dgCMatrix(x) need complete R Matrix, change display threshold options(cudasparsr.max_print = 500). installation, device verification, memory advice, common failures, see cudaverse GPU setup troubleshooting guide.

title: cudasparsr 0.1.2
text: Sparse row column names now retained across construction, format conversion, CPU/CUDA storage, dgCMatrix round-trips, products, reductions. Labeled sparse-dense products reject incompatible contracted dimensions.

title: cudasparsr 0.1.1
text: Large sparse objects now print compact metadata summary without materializing complete dgCMatrix; threshold controlled options(cudasparsr.max_print = 100). drop_zeros now requires one non-missing logical value instead silently treating invalid values FALSE. Declared cudatensr (>= 0.1.1) tested dense-core compatibility floor.
